items.information:

items.name: Hampshire Winter 2024

venue.name: Barton Peveril Sixth Form College
venue.address: Barton Peveril Sixth Form College, Chestnut Avenue, Eastleigh, SO50 5ZA

items.information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Spectators may attend for free!**

[![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

**PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 24 for 4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5 Blindfolded on a first come first serve basis. You can register for both and it is the first 24 to register for either who will get the places. If you are not within the first 24 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts before the competition. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in it.

items.name: TN Speedsolving Winter 2024
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TNSpeedsolvingWinter2024#24123-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Join the [Cubing Southeast Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/491409969462797/) to hear about competitions in the Southeast before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

This competition is in partnership with Team Nub LLC
![](https://i.imgur.com/vLCf2t9.png)

items.name: Hawaii Big Island Winter 2024
items.information:
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/578431091522797600/1156783553196085308/311822565_10159863148208791_5265841507458045856_n.png)
### Speedcubing returns to the Big Island with another WCA competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
